title: Arithmetic pseudo-Frobenius numbers and determinantal numerical semigroup rings
summary: Let $H=\langle a_1,\ldots,a_n\rangle$ be a numerical semigroup. A conjecture on numerical semigroup rings predicts that the defining ideal $I_H$ has a determinantal presentation if and only if the set of pseudo-Frobenius numbers of $H$ has form $\{h+α,h+2α,\ldots,h+(n-1)α\}$ for $h\ge 0, α>0$. We prove this conjecture under the condition that $h$ has a unique factorization in $H$. We also give characterization this unique-factorization condition.
